confirm.title: Enable {{name}}?
confirm.warning: It runs inside Auto Tournament's server with full access to your database, files and secrets, and inside the browser of every admin and player who opens a page it draws, with their permissions. Auto Tournament does not review or sandbox code modules. Enable it only if you trust its author as much as you trust this platform.
